rationale: The only failing gate is `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high` (exit 1): 1 high advisory, systeminformation <5.33.16 (GHSA-3f7j-7jwc-fxfj), reachable only via apps/ai-worker > @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node > @opentelemetry/instrumentation-host-metrics. It is pre-existing on origin/main and not introduced by this branch, which adds only two exact-pinned devDependencies (@opentelemetry/instrumentation-pino 0.68.0, @opentelemetry/sdk-logs 0.219.0), on no advisory path. Under the no-WARN rule the gate stays FAIL until fixed or accepted via ADR. Every gate covering the addendum's own code passed: gitleaks over the branch range, the added-line credential grep, semgrep p/security-audit (0 findings), and manual review of the uid guard, query construction, token handling and redaction. userId/tenantId export was not re-litigated (spec D5, ADR-086, AC-015).
